recipes.name: Rachel's Cranberry Chicken Salad
ingredients_raw: 0.5 cup sweetened dried cranberries (such as Ocean Spray® Craisins®)
1 pinch salt and black pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Stir chicken and mayonnaise together in a medium bowl until evenly coated. Stir in green onions, dried cranberries, apple, pecans, lime juice, dill weed, salt, and pepper.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for several hours or overnight (the flavor just gets better).

raw_recipe.headline: Rachel's Cranberry Chicken Salad
raw_recipe.description: This cranberry chicken salad made with cooked chopped chicken, mayo, pecans, apple, and tart cranberries is creamy, crunchy, and full of flavor.

review.reviewBody: Fruity and Fabulous! This is a great chicken salad and a great way to use up some leftover grilled chicken that I hand on hand. I LOVE dried cranberries so this chicken salad was right up my alley. I chopped up the chicken and opted to used celery in place of the green onions. I also chopped up a Red Delicious apple vs. shredding it. I mixed the dressing in a separate bowl before folding it into the chicken and other ingredients. For the dressing I used Hellman's light mayo and cut it with a bit of reduced fat sour cream I also used curry powder vs. dill. I'm a huge fan of dill, but for this salad I felt the curry powder just paired better. I let this set in the fridge for a few hours, after sneaking a few bits and WOW, what a wonderful combination of flavors! This was so good on whole grain bread. Thanks Rachel for a wonderful recipe!

Delicious and easy! With canned chicken and my fresh chives substituted for the green onions, I had everything on hand. To me, the lime juice is the key - I used bottled as I didn’t have fresh limes. I have made this before with chicken breast cooked overnight in the slow cooker and it’s delicious that way, as well!
I made this double recipe and everyone loved it. I added 2 stalks of celery for that extra crunch. I also crock potted the chicken in apple juice (about 1 cup) with salt and pepper. Delicious

I needed a guideline to use with what I had on hand. I had dried peaches , green apple, almond slivers, ginger and a chopped up roast chicken and the recc. dill. I think the Lime added the right zing. Will definitely try this when I have the actual items. Thank you for this road map!

Lots of changes. Used 1/4 cup mayo 1/4 cup Greek Yogurt. Added Cherries and walnuts. I cooked the chicken with olive oil rub. Added salt, pepper, garlic, and light jerk seasoning. Came out great. My wife said I should open a restaurant.

Excellent recipe and just what I was looking for to use up a rotisserie chicken. The only change I made was using dried cherries instead of the dried cranberries. I did not have any cranberries but have fallen in love with the tart dried cherries from Sam’s club. They worked really well in this recipe. Also didn’t use dill…used celery as someone else suggested.

Love it!! This is my go to Chicken salad all the time. Never have or thought to shred apples; always diced. Like the shred a lot! I add a 1/4 tsp of garlic powder. This is truly an excellent salad over lettuce or on a pretzel bun!

I used almonds because I didn't have any pecans on hand; i added chicken broth to make it a little wet and lightened up on the mayonnaise; and i also added a quarter of a red onion. Came out absolutely delicious!!!

Love this salad. It's the only chicken salad recipe I will make! Easy to change up too, but I never leave anything out. Sometimes I add pepitas or sunflower seeds. Sometimes I do pecans, sometimes walnuts. And I don't like my salads too saucy so I scale back the Mayo and often cut it half and half with plain Greek yogurt. My small children LOVE it too!!!

This was delicious and a big hit at my daughter-in-law’s baby shower. We served it on Hawaiian dinner rolls spread with a light layer of pineapple cream cheese. I left out the green onions- some family members don’t like onions- but I had added a little shake of paprika to the mix. So good!

I love this salad idea. Because I did not have some ingredients I made few changes: instead of apple I added green seedless grape, instead of pecans I added walnuts and because I love avocado I tried to add an avocado to it. Its came out just perfect!!!
Family absolutely loves this recipe!! (Someone got into it last night lol!)

I had to substitute with what I had on hand and it was still terrific....honey crisp apple vs green, white onion vs green, lemon juice vs lime. I love this recipe and am going to use it again. Already shared with others.
A keeper!. I didn't have green onions but swapped in celery. I used dried cherries (chopped a bit) instead of cranberries. And any apple I had in the house. Still really great.
Loved it. Didn’t have pecans used walnuts instead. Didnt add the onions & didn’t have the green apple so used red/yellow apple my son left here. Green would have been really good & pecans.
The textures and flavor of this chicken salad made for a yummy lunch. I omitted the pecans because I did not have any on hand.
Great, Used cooked turkey breast fresh dill Chopped sweet pickle Chopped dill pickle

Good recipe, even though I used canned chicken! I omitted the apple on purpose and the lime juice because I was out. My husband liked it, but commented I left out the celery. So I finely chopped celery and added it for lunch tomorrow. We’ll see if he notices!
This is a delicious chicken salad. I used canned white meat chicken but otherwise followed the recipe. I have made this several times and everyone loved it.
